_comment: Product figures that deliberately differ from the v0.1.4 oracle, each with its source on both
sides, the ruling and the reason, so the difference is evidence rather than drift. Fixtures
recorded from the oracle are still compared at the oracle's figure, passed explicitly by the
tests named under parity_tests; the product's figure is checked against this record by

serving_context_tokens.oracle_source: mycelium_a13_macos/model_resources.py:72-76 DEMO_CONTEXT_TOKENS: a prompt of at most 2,000 characters, a template under 100 tokens and at most 256 new tokens = 2,356, rounded up to 4,096
serving_context_tokens.product_source: crates/api/src/model_catalog.rs SERVING_CONTEXT_TOKENS, the contract value of every registered model
serving_context_tokens.ruling: owner, 16 Nov 2026 (REPORT-laneCAP, option 2): v0.2.0 serves 2,356 tokens; chunked prefill, which would bring 4,096 back inside a 4 GB consent, is v0.2.x work
serving_context_tokens.reason: Each stage worker reserves memory for a single prefill of the whole serving context (backend-mlx admission::requirements, quadratic in the context). At 4,096 that is 6,792,778,240 B for layers [0,19] and 5,992,888,832 B for [19,28] of Qwen3-0.6B, above the owner's 4,000,000,000 B self-grant, so no packaged run could serve. At 2,356 both fit (3.06 GB / 2.55 GB). Every other registered model's single-layer stage already exceeds 4 GB at 4,096 by the prefill scratch alone, so all registered models serve 2,356.
follows_it: the compile's memory plan (kv_bytes and max_rss per stage) and BuildRequest::serving_context_tokens
every stage's prepare tokens and the route's refusal above them (joined_route_context_exceeds_worker)
the chat page's limits.context_tokens and its chat_context_too_long message
the consent document's whole-model member figures (kv_bytes, load_peak_bytes, max_rss_bytes)
node-service/data/qwen2-planning.json resources.context_tokens (the headless path, pinned equal)
parity_tests: api/tests/run_model_document.rs ORACLE_CONTEXT_TOKENS (consent document, whole-model members, run-model documents)
serving_context_tokens.unchanged: budgets M16LiveKvContextTokens (4,096) is the M16 ledger's KV capacity floor, not a context limit: it reserves at least 4,096 tokens of KV, more than 2,356 needs

stage_share_max_rss_bytes.oracle_value: the modelled max_rss_bytes: ceil((2 x resident + 1 GiB + kv) x 1.15) per stage
stage_share_max_rss_bytes.oracle_source: mycelium_a13_macos/model_resources.py member_resources (load_peak_bytes x GUARD_HEADROOM); the v0.1.4 member enforces it through standing_limits(grant, required=share), standing_consent.py:252-259
stage_share_max_rss_bytes.product_value: max(modelled max_rss_bytes, the stage worker's own native reservation for its layer range at the serving context)
stage_share_max_rss_bytes.product_source: crates/planner/src/chain_compile.rs plan_reservation, fed by crates/node-service/src/native_selection.rs planned_reservation (backend-mlx admission::requirements); enforced by crates/api/src/joined_member/work.rs prepare_native (NativeShard::limit_memory_to)
stage_share_max_rss_bytes.ruling: owner, 16 Nov 2026 (ledger row 93, 1 a): the compile plans the worker's own reservation AND the member applies the admitted share, together
stage_share_max_rss_bytes.reason: At 2,356 tokens the v0.2 native stage worker reserves a single prefill of the whole context (quadratic scratch) that the oracle's model omits: 3,063,554,560 B for layers [0,19] and 2,548,746,752 B for [19,28] of Qwen3-0.6B, above the modelled 2,703,888,274 / 2,477,956,596 B (REVIEW-laneCAP-astra.md CAP-1). Enforcing the modelled share would refuse every prepare; the share is raised to the reservation and never lowered. A host with no native figure (oracle replays) keeps the modelled plan byte for byte.
follows_it: each stage's announced work_limits.max_rss_bytes and public resource_plan row
the proposal's max_combined_rss_bytes (2 x the largest share)
the member's worker guard limit (prepare memory)
